## SoundMesh: a shared Wi-Fi listening room

Broadcast an online music tab or downloaded audio from a laptop to browser speakers on the same Wi-Fi. Join with a QR code and adjust stereo roles, timing, volume, and three-band EQ.

### Windows quick start
1. Download and extract **SoundMesh-Windows-x64.zip**.
2. Double-click **Run SoundMesh.cmd**. Chrome opens the current host invitation automatically; Edge is the fallback.
3. Join phones using the QR code, then tap **Enable this speaker**.
4. Select **Live audio** or **Music file**.
5. Double-click **Stop SoundMesh.cmd** when finished.

The ZIP includes its runtime and licenses. No Node installation or npm command is needed. Extract the complete folder before running. Allow trusted Private-network access if Windows requests it.

Includes continuous laptop playback, adjustable buffering, per-device controls, six EQ presets, room-wide EQ defaults, and clean portable packaging. Live capture is laptop-first; iPhone receivers do not capture arbitrary audio from other apps. Stereo roles are supported; object-based 3D audio is not implemented. Keep pages awake, use one enabled page per physical output, and begin at low volume.

`SHA256SUMS.txt` inside the folder covers packaged files; the separate `.sha256` file covers the ZIP. The distribution contains no active room session, music files, or private invitations.
